sentences.en: Algeria has a vast amount of biodiversity in the north.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚北部拥有丰富的生物多样性。

sentences.en: A biodiversity sanctuary in Brazil called The Pantanal is threatened by deforestation.
sentences.zh: 巴西的一个名为潘塔纳尔的生物多样性保护区正受到滥伐森林的威胁。

sentences.en: Some areas of Algeria are rich in biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的一些地区生物多样性丰富。
